description: Scoped module-type declaration for this directory only (Stage 18 Phase 1, mirrors intelligence-platform/package.json/evidence-registry/package.json) -- eliminates Node's MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning when running this directory's own test suite directly under plain `node`. Does not affect workers/intel-gateway/package.json or wrangler's build. Scoped intentionally: Node resolves module type from the nearest package.json to each file, so this has zero effect outside this directory.
